data.rationale: The proposal captures the overall goal (GitHub profile research, lead email to hiring, discard) but omits the blog parameter and the step of opening the blog in a new tab to get the latest post title, ignores the follower count step and the tab switching, adds an unneeded Users filter step, and lists findings (followers, top_repo, stars, latest_post) as input parameters; the hiring address is hardcoded in the true workflow but treated as a parameter here, and "Discard (or Send)" is ambiguous and risky, so an automation could not be built reliably from it.
